title: kv-cache: adaptive eviction + spillover + defrag scheduler (v36)
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: Under heavy multi-tenant workloads we observed increased tail latency and reduced effective KV hit rate due to fragmentation and suboptimal eviction decisions when memory pressure triggers paging or spillover. This PR implements an adaptive eviction pipeline that combines fragmentation-aware compaction, per-shard LRU with age-weighted scoring, and an async spillover/paging mechanism to host memory. It also introduces a defrag scheduler that runs low-priority compaction and coalescing jobs without impacting critical inference paths. The goal is to reduce unnecessary evictions of recently-used KV segments, lower host spillover frequency, and improve tail latency/throughput under mixed sequence length workloads.
summary: Implements fragmentation-aware scoring, async spillover to host RAM with on-demand prefetch, defrag/compaction scheduler, and config knobs + perf tests
commit_messages: initial: add eviction score calculation and unit tests
spillover: async spillover/prefetch worker and mmap-backed host store
defrag: scheduler + compaction job queue with priority tiers
perf: microbench harness and benchmark scripts for multi-tenant traces
test: flaky test fixes and additional integration tests for spillover edge cases
docs: runtime config docs and rollout notes
diff_snippets: + double EvictionScore::compute(const EntryMeta& e) { return base_score(e) * fragmentation_factor(e.shard); }
+ class SpillWorker { void async_spill(EntryId id); void prefetch_on_demand(EntryId id); }
+ DefragScheduler::enqueue(ShardId s, Priority p) { /* low-pri compaction using free windows */ }
- removed old naive LRU eviction path in eviction_policy.cc
performance_results: 12% lower 95th latency on mixed-length 90/10 production trace (A/B vs main)
6-9% higher effective KV hit rate under multi-tenant burst tests
~2x reduction in host spillover IO when defrag scheduler enabled
release_notes: Adaptive KV cache eviction: fragmentation-aware scoring, background compaction/defrag scheduler, async spillover to host RAM with prefetch. Improves tail latency and reduces spillover IO. Config flags added under runtime.kv_cache.* for controlled rollouts.
rollout_plan: Default disabled. Enable via runtime.kv_cache.adaptive_eviction=true per-cluster. Start with canary on dedicated pool with 5% traffic, monitor kv_cache.* metrics and tail latency dashboards. Ramp over 48-72h if no regressions.
observability_changes: Added kv_cache.fragmentation_ratio, kv_cache.spill_count, kv_cache.prefetch_latency, kv_cache.defrag_jobs_active. Dashboard kv-cache-overview updated to include new charts.
test_summary: Adds unit tests for eviction scoring, integration tests for spillover/prefetch correctness, and a benchmark harness to replay production traces. Addressed flaky prefetch timing in integration tests by switching to condition-variable-driven ordering.
ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (flaky test initially failed, re-run fixed)
review_conversation: Ethan Park: Can you add a brief explanation of the fragmentation metric and why it's shard-local vs global? Also please include expected CPU overhead for defrag jobs.

Priya Raman: Fragmentation is shard-local to keep scoring cheap and allow per-shard compaction windows; added doc section and microbench showing defrag < 2% CPU on steady state and spikes handled by low-priority scheduling.
Marco Alvarez: Prefer explicit backpressure on prefetch when host store latency spikes to avoid cascading memory pressure. Suggest adding a circuit-breaker metric.
Priya Raman: Added kv_cache.prefetch_circuit_breaker and a 5s cooldown with exponential backoff; updated tests to exercise the breaker path.
Lina Zhou: Integration test looks good. Please include a note in the rollout plan to monitor kv_cache.spill_count and kv_cache.prefetch_latency. Approving after CI green.
Ethan Park: +1 after addressing small nits on config naming and adding a comment about failing over to smaller model variants when spillover occurs.
Priya Raman: Applied nits, added fallback comment, and bumped test timeouts to avoid flakes. CI rerun succeeded. Merging with squash.
GitHub Action: merge (squash) completed by Priya Raman
merge_details: merged via squash on 2026-02-24. Commit message consolidated and release notes appended to changelog.
notes_for_ops: When enabling in production, watch kv_cache.fragmentation_ratio and kv_cache.defrag_jobs_active. If defrag CPU > 5% sustained, reduce runtime.kv_cache.defrag_parallelism or increase defrag_idle_window_ms. Host store requires at least 8GB reserved for spillover on 8-GPU nodes.
security_considerations: Spillover store uses mmap-backed host store; access restricted to runtime user. No network exposure. Added unit tests for hoststore access permissions.
changelog_entry: Runtime: Adaptive KV cache eviction + spillover + defrag scheduler (Priya Raman). Improves tail latency and reduces host IO under mixed workloads.
notes: This PR is part of a long-running series of KV cache improvements. Follow-up tasks: refine scoring weights per-model class, expose adaptive knobs in Redwood Console, and add experiments for hybrid in-GPU compression before spillover.
